engine_level_trtexec_gpu_compute_ms.note: unet INT8 1.6-1.8x faster (bottleneck, xN steps); obs_encoder INT8 SLOWER (11M + InstanceNorm->FP16 fallback reformat)

wall_clock_predict_action_ms.harness: bench_predict_action.py (ctypes+libcudart, real DDIM loop w/ host numpy step + H2D/D2H), warmup=5 iters=20
wall_clock_predict_action_ms.note: end-to-end INT8 speedup 1.6x@ddim50, 1.5x@ddim16, ~1.0x@ddim5 (fixed overhead dominates at low steps); encoder precision irrelevant end-to-end (runs x1)

diag_breakdown_ddim50_unet_int8_ms.note: engine exec 93% / orchestration 7%; tight back-to-back unet loop = 2.671 ms/exec (trtexec plain 2.43 + Python ~0.22)

key_correction: trtexec cudaGraph engine-sum (50x1.96+0.52~98.5ms -> '10.1Hz @ DDIM-50') is an UNREALISTIC floor: a Python DDIM loop cannot use cudaGraph (host numpy step breaks capture). Real wall-clock DDIM-50 = 147ms/6.8Hz, does NOT cross 10Hz; 10Hz crossed only at DDIM-16 (18Hz).
